text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I can run anywhere... To the ends of the 
earth... on and on..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Beneath my feet... there is no ground at 
all... I'm simply sliding... atop the 
gears..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Is it weird... that I don't get 
tired in races?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is correct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Manhattan Cafe was suddenly 
confronted with an unexpected argument by 
Eishin Flash in the classroom.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I counted up Cafe-san's victories. Her 
record in long-distance races really 
stands out, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Normally, when stamina runs out, one falls 
back with absolute precision, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"In Cafe-san's case, there are times when 
that just doesn't work."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Never stopping, anywhere. Never falling, 
anywhere. As if unbound by rules or 
logic..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Just like a... Gespenst... An empty soul, 
flying endlessly without end..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
――This throws off our schedule, which is 
troublesome. Please perform according to 
your potential.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that troubles you...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... as for the reason why I've been able 
to perform so well in long-distance 
races...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's most likely her "claws"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Unlike sprint races that demand 
explosive power in an instant, it puts 
less strain on the tips of the hooves...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And as a result of running while trying to 
protect my hooves as much as possible, 
just as Trainer instructed...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's reducing various kinds of wear 
and tear...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
An inescapable yoke... If you try to break 
free from it... things might take a turn 
for the better...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An innate weakness... Perhaps even that 
blossomed into one of her strengths."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or, thinking about it fantastically, 
Manhattan Cafe is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having such a faint presence, she might 
have even been liberated from gravity. 
—Just like a specter.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo, Manhattan Cafe! Thou hast conquered 
2 or more long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you are hereby commended! 
Splendid! Keep striving for greater 
heights!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... very much. So that I may 
continue to achieve many great feats going 
forward...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Distance" seemed to be something 
Manhattan Cafe had no reason to fear.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo, Manhattan Cafe! Thou hast conquered 
4 or more long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you are hereby commended! 
Magnificent! Acclaimed! Keep up the 
brilliant work!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Sometimes I find it strange. Why the 
Umamusume around me drop back and 
disappear..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone grew wary of Manhattan Cafe. 
Saying, "In the end, it's always her 
standing at the finish."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Bravo, Manhattan Cafe! Thou hast conquered 
6 or more long-distance races!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, you are hereby commended! 
Legendary! Unyielding! Earth-shattering!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you... very much.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps I am no longer myself. Sometimes, 
it feels as though only my soul is racing 
forward..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to be transcending beyond this 
realm... Manhattan Cafe had established a 
terrifying, awe-inspiring monumental 
achievement.
